# Stims — MilkDrop Browser Music Visualizer (toil.fyi)

> Stims is a high-performance, web-native music visualizer supporting WebGL and WebGPU rendering, preset generation, AI preset refinement, audio reactivity, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

## Core Links & Resources
- **Live Visualizer**: https://toil.fyi/
- **Full Agent Documentation**: https://toil.fyi/llms-full.txt
- **MCP Endpoint (HTTP/SSE)**: https://toil.fyi/mcp
- **Preset Catalog**: https://toil.fyi/milkdrop-presets/catalog.json
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/zz-plant/stims

## Guides (static pages)
- **Learn to write MilkDrop presets** (10-track course): https://toil.fyi/learn/
- **MilkDrop online, in your browser**: https://toil.fyi/learn/milkdrop-online/

- **MilkDrop language reference**: https://toil.fyi/learn/reference/
- **Compatibility and performance**: https://toil.fyi/performance/

## Key URL Parameters for AI Agents
- `?agent=true`: Enables low-overhead, automation-friendly mode.
- `?preset=<id>`: Loads a specific preset by ID (e.g. `?preset=shifter-snakeskin`).
- `?renderer=webgpu` or `?renderer=webgl`: Forces specific rendering engine backend.
- `#code=<base64>`: Instant URL deep-link containing base64-encoded `.milk` source code.

## Main API Endpoints
- `POST /api/validate-preset`: Validate MilkDrop `.milk` code syntax and return diagnostic JSON.
- `POST /api/generate-preset`: Generate `.milk` equations from text description.
- `POST /api/blend-presets`: Blend wave patterns and color schemes of two presets.
- `POST /api/refine-preset`: Iteratively refine `.milk` code based on prompt instructions.
- `POST /api/visual-search`: Search catalog visually by natural language description.

## Iframe `postMessage` Protocol
Embed `https://toil.fyi/?embed=true` (add `&preset=<id>` to choose the first preset); other URLs send `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN` and will not load in another site's frame. Post JSON messages to the iframe's `contentWindow`:
- `{ type: "toil:load_preset", presetId: "shifter-snakeskin" }`, or `milkSource: "<.milk code>"` in place of `presetId`.
- `{ type: "toil:apply_tweak", tweak: "faster motion" }`: refines the playing preset through `/api/refine-preset`. When AI is unavailable, a tweak naming blue, neon, cyan, warp, fast, speed, bass or beat applies the matching one-click restyle instead.
- `{ type: "toil:set_audio", source: "demo" }`: `"demo"` or `"microphone"` (which needs `allow="microphone"` on the iframe). File playback and tab capture need a click inside the page, so they are refused.
- `{ type: "toil:request_telemetry" }`

Listen for response messages:
- `{ type: "toil:status", action: "set_audio", success: true, source: "demo" }`: answers each command above except telemetry. For `apply_tweak` and `set_audio` it arrives once the change has landed; for `load_preset` it confirms the request was accepted, and telemetry's `currentPresetId` confirms the switch. `success: false` always carries a `reason`, including for unknown `toil:` messages.
- `{ type: "toil:telemetry", fps: 60, backend: "webgpu", audioEnergy: 0.75, currentPresetId: "..." }`
